Commentary.Commentary: The hosts on the other hand, were excellent in the death overs. They chipped in with timely wickets which stopped the run flow of the Saffas. Tom Curran had a dream debut and was the pick of the bowlers and he was well supported by the rest of the bowlers. It seems to be a under par total. The Englishmen should fancy themselves to chase this one down. Join us back in a while.

England will be happy to restrict South Africa to 174. The visitors came out all guns blazing. They were off to a flier.  JJ Smuts scored a quickfire 45 off 35 balls. Skipper AB de Villiers hit the bowlers to all parts of the ground but after his wicket the Proteas lost their way. None of them except Farhaan Behardien contributed after that which meant they could not finish off the innings in the way they wanted.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Fuller around off, Paterson drives it uppishly over the cover region for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 174/8.
Dane Peterson will face the final ball of the innings.

OUT! That's plumb! Full into the stumps, Behardien shuffles a bit and tries to go for the slog but misses it completely. Gets rapped flush on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire is quick to raise his finger. Jordan gets his first wicket of the day.
Full toss outside off, Behardien tries to go over the cover region but fails to make contact. So another dot ball.
Fuller around off, Behardien drives it straight to the fielder at covers. No runs taken.
SIX! Huge! Full toss on the pads, Behardien stays in his crease and sends that loosener way into the square leg stands for half a dozen.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Morkel clips it towards deep mid-wicket. No runs taken. Curran ends with figures of 4-0-33-3.
Morne Morkel strides out to the middle.
OUT! Curran takes a 3-fer on debut! Fuller around off, Phehlukwayo tries to jam it out but cannot make contact. The ball goes through and rattles the stumps. Curran is having a debut to remember.
Yorker right on the money, Behardien digs it out on the off side for a single.
SIX! Another slower delivery but this goes the distance! Short delivery at a slower pace, Behardien stays deep in his crease and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Andile Phelukwayo comes out to bat.

OUT! Slower delivery lands Curran his second! Back of a length around off, Morris goes for a biggie but he cannot time it well. Gets it towards the wide long on region and Jason Roy runs to his right from long on to take a fine running catch. Livingstone will be happy that Morris could not make the most of the life he got in the last over.
Low full toss, Behardien drives it towards long on for a single.
Driven through mid off for a single.

Liam Livingstone drops a sitter! Full toss in the line of the stumps, Morris stays in his crease and slogs it over the mid-wicket region. Cannot find the distance on it as the ball goes straight to the fielder. Livingstone in the deep gets under it but cannot hold onto it. Morris survives and the batsmen run a single.
Wide! The batsman goes after a wide one and misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Wide outside off, Morris fails to make contact with it.

FOUR! Lucky runs! Short delivery around off, Morris goes for the pull, gets a top edge on it and the ball flies over the keeper's head. The keeper, the fine leg and the third man fielders chase it down but none cannot reach it. Willey puts in a dive after running in from third man but to no advantage as the ball reaces away to the fence.
Eased towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Powerful! Fuller outside off, Behardien stays in his crease and hammers it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.

Dropped! Fuller delivery outside off,  Behardien smacks it powerfully to the fielder at mid off. Jordan cannot hold onto it as it came like a rocket towards him. The ball bounces off his hands, then hits hit jaws and then falls down. The batsmen run a single in the process.
FOUR! Good shot! Full outside off, Behardien stays in his crease and carves it over the cover region for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, Morris goes for a biggie. Gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a single.
Short around off this time, Behardien drags it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full into the stumps at a slower pace, Morris somehow digs it out off the inside edge on to his pads and the ball rolls on the off side. The batsmen run for a single .
Full toss outside off, Morris drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Slower delivery on a back of a length around off, the batsman dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Slow bouncer and Morris pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Morris tries to dig it out. Gets it off the inner half through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Short into the batsman, Morris pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Slower delivery around middle and leg, Morris comes down the track and drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angling into the hips, the batsman clips it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Tom Curran is back into the attack.
Behardien clips it on the leg side for a single.
Short outside off, Morris pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Behardien tries to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen run a single.
Chris Morris strides out to the middle.

OUT! AB departs! Length delivery outside off, de Villiers tries to go over covers for a maximum. Mistimes it and the ball balloons over the fielder at extra cover. Morgan gets underneath it and takes a really fine catch to send his counterpart back.

SIX! Mr. 360 is at his best! AB de Villiers shuffles way across and Willey bowls a good length delivery outside off. De Villiers smacks it over the short fine leg region for a handsome maximum. That went way into the stands.
Short delivery and Behardien pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
David Willey is brought back for a bowl.
AB de Villiers goes leg side and Plunkett is smart to follow him this time. Short delivery into the body, de Villiers just manages to defend it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller outside off, AB pierces this one through the gap between cover and mid off for a boundary. That came straight off the middle.
Short delivery outside off, AB de Villiers stands in his crease and guides it through the point region for a couple.
Behardien pushes it towards covers for a single.
Farhaan Behardien is the next man in.

OUT! Plunkett strikes again! Short delivery outside off at a slower pace, Miller tries to cut it on the off side. Gets a feather edge on it and the ball goes through to the keeper. Buttler makes no mistake and he pouches it safely to send the dangerous Miller back to the hut.
Back of a length delivery into the body, Miller fends it on the leg side.
Liam Plunkett is back for his last over.
A bit short and Miller is quick to go back and punch it towards the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
Miller camps back and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a double.
Shorter around off, Miller slaps it through the cover region for a couple.
De Villiers punches it through the cover region for a single.
SIX! AB de Villiers, on the charge! Shuffles across and Dawson bowls it on the leg stump, AB just kneels down and sweeps it over the backward square leg region for a biggie.
Floated around off, Miller comes down the track and lofts it towards long on for a single.
Angling into the pads, Miller clips it through the square leg region for a single. A really good over by Jordan, just four runs off the over. 100 up for South Africa!
Short and wide outside off, Miller steps out of his crease and throws his bat towards it. Cannot reach it and hopes for a wide but nothing given by the umpire.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Miller tries to cut it on the off side. Fails to make contact and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Miller defends it on the off side and scampers across for a quick single.
De Villiers clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Chris Jordan is called back for a bowl.
David Miller makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Dawson gets a wicket on a poor delivery! How often have we seen that? Full toss down the leg side, Smuts tries to go big again. Gets a top edge on it and the ball flies towards the short fine leg region. Plunkett gets underneath it and takes a simple catch. An entertaining knock from Smuts comes to an end.
Shorter into the pads, de Villiers pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Smuts clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
SIX! That's gone way into the stands! Floats this one around off, Smuts comes down the track and slogs it over the wide long on region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Smashed! Short outside off, Smuts dances down the track and slaps it through the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Smuts comes forward and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
SIX! BANG! Over covers, full ball outside off, de Villiers makes room and lofts it over covers for a maximum. 21 off that over. It is a big one for South Africa.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over. De Villiers makes room. Plunkett tries a slower one which ends up being a full toss. De Villiers hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower short ball on the body, Smuts pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
WIDE! Fast bouncer down the leg side, Smuts goes for the pull but misses and the umpire signals wide.
Bowls it on middle, the batsman plays it through leg side for a run. Smart by de Villiers.
FOUR! Showing some intent here, de Villiers. Length ball outside off. He comes down the track and tries to hit it over mid off but gets an outside edge and the ball races to the third man fence.
FOUR! He hits it with one hand. Short ball on middle. De Villiers stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker delivery outside off, Smuts tries to cut it past point but fails to make contact. Just 3 runs off it.
Shorter in line of the stumps, AB de Villiers pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, de Villiers drives it towards the fielder at covers. No runs taken.
Smuts clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller outside off, Smuts mistimes his heave back to the bowler.
Quicker and fuller in the line of the stumps, AB de Villiers plays the reverse sweep fine past the keeper for a single towards short third man.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A tad fuller outside off, de Villiers drives it beautifully through covers for a couple.
AB de Villiers is the next man in.

OUT!  The short ball ploy works. Bangs it in short on leg. Mosehle goes for the pull but the ball brushes his glove on its way to the keeper. Buttler  dives forward and takes a good low catch. Mosehle departs after a good cameo. England would want to build on this wicket now.
Bangs it short, Smuts goes for the pull but does not hit the middle and goes through square leg for a run.
Short again, Mosehle this time manages to pull it through square leg for a run.
BOUNCER! A good bouncer on middle, the batsman goes for the pull but later decides to not go for it. But still ends up hitting it towards the point region.
Liam Plunkett comes back into the attack.
Quicker on the stumps, Mosehle flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Smuts comes down the track, Dawson sees him coming and drags his length back. Smuts adjusts in the last moment and turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fires it in on off, Smuts defends it off the front foot.
SIX! This guy has some power. Bowls it on middle. Smuts comes down the track and hits way over mid-wicket for a biggie. That was some shot.
Short and sliding into the pads, nudged towards backward square leg for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Liam Dawson is into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. That's the end of the Powerplay. A really good start for South Africa.
FOUR! Straight this time. Length on middle, Mosehle lofts it straight back over the bowler for a boundary. Looks a good player this lad.
Change of bat for Mangaliso Mosehle. He seems to have damaged his bat while hitting the ball for a biggie.
SIX! WOW! Length ball on off, Mosehle heaves it off the front foot over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. That was one hell of a shot.
Bowls it on the pads, Smuts flicks it towards short fine leg and takes off for a single. Dawson has a shy at the striker's end but no damage done in the end.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! SMASHED! Full ball on off, Smuts stands tall and smashes it straight back past the bowler who tries to get a hand on it but does not. The ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end and races away to the long off fence. The umpire was quick to get out of the way there.
A tad fuller on middle, Smuts pushes it to mid on for a run.
Mosehle pulls the ball through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on middle, Mosehle tries to flick it but gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball rolls to first slip.
Bangs it a tad short on leg, Mosehle goes for the flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Angles it on the pads, JJ Smuts flicks it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Smuts defends it off the back foot.
Liam Plunkett is brought into the attack.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball on off, Smuts goes to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
That was close! Length ball on off, jags back in a little, Smuts goes to push it through the off side but gets a bottom edge on it and the ball goes past the stumps.
Full on the pads, Mosehle flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Mangaliso Mosehle comes into bat.

OUT! CURRAN GETS HIS MAIDEN WICKET! A tad short outside off, Hendricks tries to drag it through the leg side but gets a  bottom edge onto the stumps. Tom Curran is pumped up, you can see the happiness in his celebration. South Africa lose their first wicket.
In the air.... but safe! Curran bangs it in short, Hendricks goes for the pull but gets a top edge and it just clears short fine leg. The bastmen run two. He almost got a wicket off his first ball.
Tom Curran is introduced into the attack.
Back of a length around off, Hendricks nudges it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Smuts flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Smuts goes for the cut but gets beaten.
A tad short outside off, Smuts mistimes his slap to mid on for no run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hendricks plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Good length ball angling away, Hendricks defends it off the front foot.
SIX! BANG! Very full outside off, Smuts just lofts it over long off for a maximum. 20 off the first 2 overs.
WIDE! Almost a replica of the previous wide. Slower ball way outside off and the umpire signals a wide.
Length ball on off, Smuts punches it off the back foot on the off side.
WIDE! What was that? Jordan tries to bowl a slower ball but gets it completely wrong and sprays it wide outside off. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Slower delivery on a fuller length around off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Bowls it around off, Hendricks flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Short on the stumps, Hendricks pulls it towards long leg for a couple.
WIDE! Slips it down the leg side. Hendricks misses the flick and the umpire signals wide.
Back of a length on off, the batsman pushes it to covers off the back foot.
Chris Jordan will bowl from the other end.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Poor there by Jordan. Full ball on off, Smuts drives it towards Jordan at mid off who lets it through his legs. The ball races away to the fence.
Lovely stop by Morgan! Short and outside off, Smuts cuts it towards point. Morgan dives to his left and stops it.
A tad short outside off, Willey gets some extra bounce. Smuts goes for the cut but gets beaten.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Smuts drives it beautifully through the extra cover region and the ball races away to the fence. They are underway. First boundary of the day.
Starts off with a fullish delivery outside off, shapes back in and Smuts lets it go through. A brave leave there.

The players and the umpires are out in the middle. JJ Smuts and Reeza Hendricks will open the batting for South Africa. David Willey will start the proceedings with the new ball for England. A slip in place. Here we go...

TOSS - ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD! Both the teams have made three changes each. England bring in Liam Livingstone, Tom Curran and Liam Plunkett for Alex Hales, Mark Wood and Mason Crane. For South Africa, Imran Tahir, Dwaine Pretorius and Wayne Parnell make way for Chris Morris, Morne Morkel and Dane Paterson. Tom Curran and Liam Livingstone will make their International debuts for England today.

South Africa on the other hand lacked intent in the first encounter. They were below par in all three departments. AB de Villiers would desperately need a win today and will hope that his teammates step up. The visitors might bring in Chris Morris to add some firepower to their batting and bowling. Will England clinch the series today itself or will the Saffas stay alive with a win?

Hello and welcome to the 2nd T20I between England and South Africa in Taunton. The home side took a 1-0 lead by beating the visitors quite convincingly in the first game. The English bowlers hardly gave anything away and set the game for them. They look a very balanced outfit and Eoin Morgan will hope that they carry the momentum forward. Mark Wood who was very influential with the ball has been rested for the rest of the series. Tom Curran might get a game today.
